bibliography.abstract: In the context of digital protection and revitalization of traditional villages, identifying the micro-space design style of Lingnan ancient villages has become a key link in protecting cultural heritage. However, traditional manual identification methods are inefficient and highly subjective. Existing deep learning models mostly focus on classifying the overall style of a single building. It is difficult to take into account the details of local components in the micro-space and the multi-scale characteristics of the overall spatial structure. Therefore, a computable feature description system for the micro-space of Lingnan ancient villages covering dimensions such as visual features, spatial forms, component features and cultural symbols is constructed. Taking EfficientNet-B0 as the basic framework, the multi-scale feature fusion module, parameter-free attention mechanism and Ghost lightweight convolution are combined to build a Lingnan ancient village micro-space design style prediction model. Experiments based on self-built data sets showed that the accuracy reached 92.55%, which was significantly better than that of the comparison model. The parameter size was only 4.27 M, and the number of floating point operations per second was 0.43 G, achieving a balance between precision and lightweight. Under small sample conditions, the model maintained an accuracy of 82.33% and above. In complex collection environments such as low light, the accuracy reached 83.17%. The proposed model has significant advantages in fine-grained recognition accuracy, convergence stability, anti-interference ability in complex scenes, and lightweight deployment performance. It can provide effective technical support for identifying micro-space design styles of Lingnan ancient villages, and protecting characteristic features.
bibliography.title: Improved EfficientNet Lingnan ancient village micro-space design style prediction model integrating multi-scale features

topics.label: Advanced Image and Video Retrieval Techniques

en.caveats: The performance metrics rely entirely on a custom, self-built dataset that may not reflect real-world deployments across broader regional styles.
en.what: The authors developed a computable feature system covering visual characteristics, spatial form, component details, and cultural symbols to classify Lingnan ancient village micro-spaces. Using EfficientNet-B0 as a baseline, they integrated a multi-scale feature fusion module, a parameter-free attention mechanism, and Ghost lightweight convolutions to build a fine-grained style prediction model. Evaluated on a custom dataset, the model achieved 92.55% accuracy with 4.27M parameters and 0.43G FLOPS, maintaining above 82.33% accuracy on small samples and 83.17% in low-light environments.
en.why: The lightweight model allows automated, fine-grained micro-space style classification on low-power devices, replacing subjective manual auditing for rural architectural heritage preservation.
